description: This file defines macros, types, and inline functions for declaring and managing thread stacks in the Zephyr RTOS kernel, including stack alignment, declaration, and section placement.

methods.name: z_stack_ptr_align
methods.description: Aligns a given stack pointer to the architecture's stack pointer alignment requirements.

methods.name: Z_STACK_PTR_TO_FRAME
methods.description: Macro to get a stack frame struct pointer from a stack pointer.

methods.name: Z_KERNEL_STACK_BUFFER
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the non-reserved area of a kernel stack.
